ambient_events: A corroded access ladder climbs the shaft wall to a manhole rusted shut generations ago.
The drop below exhales cold, wet air up past your face.
Flakes of rust tick down the ladder rungs one by one.
description: A vertical service shaft where the tunnel steps down a full level, an old iron ladder bolted to one weeping wall. The manhole at the top is welded fast under a street that forgot it. Everything past here is deeper than the maintenance crews ever liked to go — and it feels it.
name: Ladder Shaft
